data.case_title: Working hours increase from Beispielsoft Solutions
data.title: Notice of increased weekly working hours from January 2027
data.summary: Beispielsoft Solutions GmbH (People & Culture) informs Harriet Collins that her weekly working hours will rise from 32 to 40 hours from 1 January 2027, with salary adjusted accordingly, and asks her to sign and return one copy of the enclosed contract amendment by 11 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your employer wants to increase your weekly hours from 32 to 40, with a corresponding pay rise, starting 1 January 2027. An amendment to your employment contract is enclosed; you need to sign both copies and send one back to People & Culture by the stated deadline so payroll can process the change in time. If you miss the deadline, the change may not be applied correctly in January's payroll. If you disagree with the new terms, raise it with People & Culture before signing, since signing confirms your agreement.

change.quote: As agreed in your review meeting, your weekly hours will rise from 32 to 40 from 1 January 2027, with your salary adjusted accordingly.

items.title: Sign and return the contract amendment
items.action: Sign both copies of the enclosed contract amendment and send one signed copy back to People & Culture.
items.consequence: Payroll may not be able to apply the new hours and salary from January if the signed copy is not returned in time.

date.text: Please sign both copies and return one to People & Culture by 11 December 2026

items.quote: Please sign both copies and return one to People & Culture by 11 December 2026 so that payroll can apply the change in January.
